claim: At the helper level: lookupRestaurantRole (apps/api-gateway/src/organizations/organizations.service.ts) returns role null with readError set, and does not read users, when the user_restaurant_access read errors. It reads the person's one access row whatever its is_active, with is_active, valid_from and valid_until. A row that exists decides alone: it gives its role only while isLiveMembership (common/tenant/live-membership.ts) holds and the role is non-empty, and users is not read. Only a read that found no row falls back to users.role when users.restaurant_id is this house. MembersService.assertMembership (apps/api-gateway/src/restaurants/members.service.ts) applies the same three rules, answering 403 on an access-read error and on a row that is not live (except for a person removing themself, below), and keeps users.role || "staff" for no row at all. ProcurementService.assertApprovalAllowed reads the role through OrganizationsService.readRestaurantRole and turns RestaurantRoleUnreadableError into a 500 before parkOrderAwaitingApproval and recordApprovalRefusal. (ADR 0248, founder 2026-10-01: "Next PR: error means no role (Recommended)", "Strict for the order seal (Recommended)", "Fold into #561 (Recommended)", "Close both in #561".) At 2019ae7f6 both helpers read only active rows, ignored the window and fell back to users.role on an access-read error, and the seal read the role non-strictly. isLiveMembership (common/tenant/live-membership.ts), which both helpers apply, treats a valid_from up to VALID_FROM_CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS = 120_000 ms ahead of now as started, inclusive at the boundary, with no tolerance on valid_until (founder 2026-10-01: "Small tolerance on valid_from (Recommended)"). Pinned by role-read-error-means-no-role.spec.ts (17 [REVERT-FAILS] cases red on 2019ae7f6, and 4 more red with live-membership.ts at 1c1a676f8, which had no tolerance), order-approval-gate.spec.ts (4, red on 2019ae7f6) and members.service.spec.ts (5 red on 2019ae7f6, and 1 more red with live-membership.ts at 1c1a676f8). Reach over HTTP: AuthService.validateJwtPayload (auth.service.ts:1426-1493) runs first on every route behind JwtAuthGuard and reads the token's house's active access row, answering 503 when that read errors and 401 when there is none, without reading the window. So the access-read-error and inactive-row paths reach these helpers over HTTP only on GET/PATCH /organizations/locations/:id (house from :id, not tenant-compared), or when the JWT step's read succeeded and the helper's own read errored. The window and empty-role paths pass the JWT step. The recurring-orders cron (procurement/recurring-orders.service.ts:956) reaches the seal with no JWT step. MembersService.removeMember passes assertMembership opts.removingSelf only when a person removes themself (the leave route, and DELETE /auth/me through auth.service.ts:4538); then a row that exists admits them whether or not it is live, at its role or staff, while an access-read error still gives no role and removing someone else still needs a live owner or manager row (founder 2026-10-01: "Let leaving and deletion through (Recommended)"). No other gateway file passes removingSelf. Pinned by leave-and-delete-account.routes.spec.ts: 3 [REVERT-FAILS] cases red with members.service.ts at 5cd2fb001^ (the commit before this change on the rebased branch), and an expired manager refused when removing another member, red at 2019ae7f6.
